name: ZenFactor Spa
author: Tristano Ajmone; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: A short tutorial adventure: visit a company in Turin to find out what text adventures are about. Text adventure in Italian (Tristano Ajmone, 2010). Type if-zenfactor-spa in the Terminal or tap the icon.

descriptions.en: A short tutorial adventure: visit a company in Turin to find out what text adventures are about. Text adventure in Italian (Tristano Ajmone, 2010). Type if-zenfactor-spa in the Terminal or tap the icon.
